# LuminousDragonGames — Parallax Space Scene

Canonical source:
https://opengameart.org/node/76609

Author: LuminousDragonGames
License: CC0

The source is explicitly designed as a layered parallax space scene.
Imported through the reproducible GitHub mirror:
https://github.com/sandwichfarm/hyprlax/tree/master/examples/space

Vendored files:
- stars-dense.png <- bkgd_1.png
- stars-sparse.png <- bkgd_3.png
- stars-planets.png <- bkgd_4.png
- asteroid-field.png <- bkgd_7.png

Production use:
- far/mid star hierarchy and tiny celestial detail;
- distant asteroid/debris field;
- runtime performs only composition/parallax/drift/opacity;
- do not upscale these layers into near-camera hero art.
